title: Flatness survives restriction to a slice
statement: Let $(\mathcal C,\mathcal O)$ be a ringed site, let $U$ be an object of $\mathcal C$, and let $\mathcal F$ be a flat $\mathcal O$-module [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. Then the restriction $\mathcal F|_U$ is a flat $\mathcal O_U$-module on the slice site over $U$.
